Title: Start the packaged demo
Setup: Use the DIGS! desktop shortcut or provided launch script
Steps: Confirm the shortcut shows the pixel miner then start the demo and wait for the title screen
Expected Result: The shortcut uses the exact in-game left-facing miner and the DIGS title screen appears without an error
Evidence Requested: Desktop and title-screen screenshots plus build ID

Title: Configure a match
Setup: Open Start Match from the title screen
Steps: Cycle local players from 1 through 2 and bots from 0 through 2; select each mode map style seed and arsenal
Expected Result: Every value changes within its documented range and Enter starts the selected match
Evidence Requested: Setup-screen screenshot and notes for any value that cannot be selected

Title: Restart the same seed
Setup: Start a match and make a visible terrain change
Steps: Press R and compare the regenerated terrain with the initial layout
Expected Result: The same map style and seed recreate the same starting terrain
Evidence Requested: Before-and-after screenshots with the visible seed

Title: Coal Ridge generation
Setup: Select Coal Ridge and a recorded seed
Steps: Traverse its land masses and inspect seams drifts and high anchors
Expected Result: The arena has broad rolling ground with exposed coal seams sand drifts sparse high rope anchors and visible lava beyond safe land
Evidence Requested: Seed landform and full-arena screenshot

Title: Deepworks generation
Setup: Select Deepworks and a recorded seed
Steps: Enter the surface shafts and trace connected chambers firedamp pockets and natural anchors
Expected Result: The arena has connected chambers and surface-accessible vertical shafts with clustered firedamp and stone or coal rope routes
Evidence Requested: Seed and chamber-route screenshots

Title: Furnace Yard generation
Setup: Select Furnace Yard and a recorded seed
Steps: Traverse its terraces broken gantries open gaps and contained hot regions
Expected Result: The industrial arena is structurally distinct with suspended gantries and limited heat or lava pockets but no surface-to-sky tower blocks the walk lane
Evidence Requested: Seed and full-arena screenshot

Title: Movement jump and steam jet
Setup: Start any match
Steps: Move left and right; jump; hold either Shift until steam drops; release Shift
Expected Result: Movement remains responsive; the miner jumps; steam provides lift and then recharges
Evidence Requested: Short capture or notes including frame cap and input device

Title: Pick and sledge terrain edits
Setup: Use Full Works and select keys 1 and 6
Steps: Aim at nearby terrain and use each tool several times
Expected Result: Pick makes precise edits and sledge makes a broader close-range impact
Evidence Requested: Before-and-after screenshots

Title: Projectile arsenal
Setup: Use Full Works and select keys 2 through 0
Steps: Fire every ranged weapon at terrain and at a miner while observing cooldowns
Expected Result: All eight ranged slots fire their documented projectile or material effect and affect the authoritative match
Evidence Requested: Short capture and a list of every slot tested

Title: Falling material behavior
Setup: Use a map or Foundry area containing sand and loose effects
Steps: Dislodge sand and observe it for several simulation seconds
Expected Result: Sand falls into available space instead of remaining suspended
Evidence Requested: Before-and-after screenshots

Title: Water lava cooling reaction
Setup: Use the Pressure Hose near lava
Steps: Direct water into lava and observe the contact region
Expected Result: The contact produces solid stone and hot smoke as the demo steam representation
Evidence Requested: Short capture focused on the contact cells

Title: Fire and firedamp reaction
Setup: Use Deepworks or the Foundry near firedamp and a heat source
Steps: Ignite the exposed gas and observe the bounded reaction
Expected Result: Firedamp ignites and produces a localized terrain blast without corrupting the match
Evidence Requested: Short capture plus seed and location

Title: Damage death gore and respawn
Setup: Start a match with at least one bot
Steps: Deal lethal damage and continue observing the victim
Expected Result: Health decreases; death produces voxel effects; the victim respawns after the fixed delay unless the match ended
Evidence Requested: Short capture and score before and after

Title: Authoritative bot combat
Setup: Start a match with 1 or 2 bots
Steps: Observe movement and combat for at least 30 seconds
Expected Result: Bots acquire targets; move; attack; take damage; die; and score through the same match rules
Evidence Requested: Seed bot count and 30-second notes or capture

Title: Visible basin and rising lava endgame
Setup: Start a match then run a short test build or wait for the final 30 seconds
Steps: Observe the initial lower boundary then allow a miner to touch lava before and during its rise
Expected Result: A real emissive lava basin is visible from match start; contact damages or kills; and the surface later rises monotonically through physical world cells
Evidence Requested: Initial and timed screenshots plus debug tick

Title: Lightfield quality tiers
Setup: Open Options and use the same scene for Compatibility Balanced and Showcase
Steps: Cycle all three tiers and inspect lava hot cells smoke and shadowed terrain
Expected Result: Each tier renders correctly and higher tiers show wider light propagation without changing gameplay state
Evidence Requested: Three matched screenshots with tier labels

Title: Frame-cap choices
Setup: Open Options and enable the F1 overlay
Steps: Test 30 60 90 120 144 and Unlimited for at least 10 seconds each
Expected Result: Every cap can be selected; presentation remains responsive; simulation advances at fixed 60 Hz
Evidence Requested: Overlay notes for every cap

Title: Debug overlay
Setup: Start a match and press F1
Steps: Observe the overlay while moving firing and changing materials
Expected Result: The overlay toggles cleanly and its tick hash material and performance fields continue updating
Evidence Requested: Screenshot of the enabled overlay

Title: Resize letterbox and fullscreen
Setup: Run the graphical demo in a desktop session
Steps: Resize to wide and tall windows; press F11 twice
Expected Result: The image keeps its aspect ratio with stable letterboxing and fullscreen round-trips without a crash
Evidence Requested: Screenshots and desktop resolution or refresh rate

Title: Pause results and restart
Setup: Start a scored match
Steps: Press Esc; resume; reach results by score or time; start another match
Expected Result: Pause stops active play; resume returns safely; results are readable; a new match initializes cleanly
Evidence Requested: Capture or notes for each transition

Title: Procedural audio and silent fallback
Setup: Run once with a working audio device and once with audio unavailable
Steps: Fire tools and weapons in both runs
Expected Result: Procedural effects play when audio opens and gameplay continues without a crash when audio is unavailable
Evidence Requested: Audio device description and terminal output

Title: Non-windowed smoke test
Setup: Use the same digs_demo binary supplied for interactive testing
Steps: Run digs_demo --smoke-test smoke.ppm
Expected Result: The command exits zero; prints state and frame hashes; and writes a nonempty PPM without opening a window
Evidence Requested: smoke.log smoke.ppm and binary checksum

Title: CPU renderer benchmark
Setup: Close unrelated heavy workloads and record the power state
Steps: Run digs_demo --benchmark 240
Expected Result: The command exits zero and reports timing FPS and stable frame hashes for all three Lightfield tiers
Evidence Requested: benchmark.log plus CPU OS build type and power state

Title: Headless proof binaries
Setup: Use a tester bundle containing vox_headless and digs_headless beside digs_demo
Steps: Run both headless binaries
Expected Result: Each command exits zero and prints a deterministic state summary
Evidence Requested: vox-headless.log and digs-headless.log

Title: Repeat smoke hashes
Setup: Use one unchanged binary and machine
Steps: Run the smoke test twice with separate output names
Expected Result: Simulation and frame hashes match across both runs
Evidence Requested: Two smoke logs and checksums

Title: Weapon and effect pool stress
Setup: Use Full Works in Foundry or a long match
Steps: Fire rapid weapons and overlapping explosives repeatedly for at least 60 seconds
Expected Result: Bounded pool exhaustion remains safe and the match continues without a crash or corrupt terrain
Evidence Requested: 60-second capture terminal output and final state

Title: Test-bench profile
Setup: Use the intended GTX 1660 Ti laptop or another declared system
Steps: Complete launch smoke benchmark and one interactive match
Expected Result: Results clearly distinguish CPU software-renderer evidence from GPU presence and do not imply unmeasured GPU acceleration
Evidence Requested: Completed Environment sheet and cockpit evidence packet

Title: Clean exit
Setup: Start from the title screen and from a paused match
Steps: Quit through the menu and repeat with the window close control
Expected Result: The process exits promptly without a crash dialog or orphaned window
Evidence Requested: Terminal exit status and notes

Title: Fracture and structural collapse
Setup: Fire repeated Blast Charges or Concussion Grenades beneath an overhang
Steps: Compare crater edges and watch the unsupported mass after supports are severed
Expected Result: Blast edges vary deterministically and unsupported structural terrain cascades under gravity
Evidence Requested: Short capture plus seed weapon and location

Title: Shared dynamic zoom aim and bounded framing
Setup: Start a two-human match and separate the players while changing zoom with the mouse wheel
Steps: Switch P1 between mouse and controller aim then fire at several frame caps and pan toward every world edge
Expected Result: The spring camera keeps both humans readable; every reticle target and impact agree; and sky plus the lava horizon replace any would-be black exposure at every zoom and edge
Evidence Requested: Short capture plus input mode zoom frame cap and impact location

Title: Forty-times mini-voxel profile
Setup: Start a seeded match and enable the debug overlay
Steps: Inspect terrain particles explosions world span and occupied-cell count
Expected Result: The demo uses a 512x320x10 world with 1638400 granular simulated cells while the CPU renderer remains responsive
Evidence Requested: Screenshot seed occupied count memory note and benchmark output

Title: One and two human slot ownership
Setup: Open Match Setup and cycle Local Players and Bots
Steps: Start one-human plus bots and two-human plus bots matches
Expected Result: Exactly four or fewer active slots are created; local inputs never drive bots; and both humans score die and respawn independently
Evidence Requested: Setup screenshot and short capture from both match shapes

Title: Controller mapping raw fallback and hotplug
Setup: Start with no pad then connect a Logitech F310 in X mode and repeat in D mode
Steps: Test menus movement radial aim weapon-aware reach calibration disconnect and reconnect in each mode
Expected Result: Known mappings and raw fallback each produce usable logical controls; noisy rest does not move aim; disconnect follows the selected AUTO or locked-mode safety behavior
Evidence Requested: Controller mode GUID SDL version input-setting values and short capture

Title: Responsive traversal game feel
Setup: Use a continent seed and then rough terrain
Steps: Run reverse stop short-hop full-jump coyote jump-buffer and two-cell step-assist trials across a long route
Expected Result: Acceleration is readable but responsive; reversal and stopping are precise; jump height responds to hold time; and density-scaled terrain steps do not dead-stop the miner
Evidence Requested: Short capture with approximate continent traversal time

Title: Deterministic high-anchor traversal rope
Setup: Use suspended rails gantries and natural rock anchors
Steps: Aim attach swing reel release across gaps and destroy the occupied anchor
Expected Result: Rope anchors stay within 48 cells and 36 through 42 cells above nearby terrain; the lower 28 cells stay obstacle-free; release momentum and anchor destruction remain correct
Evidence Requested: Seed anchor location clearance measurement and short capture

Title: Five-second spawn shield
Setup: Start or respawn beside combat and hazards
Steps: Observe 300 ticks; receive fire impulse and environmental contact; then make an offensive attack
Expected Result: Shield blocks damage hostile impulse and environment harm for 300 ticks and ends early only on offensive use
Evidence Requested: Debug tick capture showing spawn expiry and attack cancellation

Title: Weighted shared-camera momentum
Setup: Play a two-human match with separation jumps ropes and nearby explosions
Steps: Change direction quickly and trigger local and bot-only combat
Expected Result: Camera uses smooth frame-rate-updated spring motion and subtle contextual zoom; local action affects it while distant bot-only events do not spam it
Evidence Requested: 60 and 144 FPS matched captures

Title: Flash gore shake and number controls
Setup: Open Options and cycle Full Reduced Off variants plus damage-number settings
Steps: Trigger local damage kills and explosions under each setting
Expected Result: Feedback follows the selected setting; bot-only fights do not flash the screen; and presentation-only settings do not change authoritative simulation hashes
Evidence Requested: Matched captures and hash notes

Title: Deterministic varied explosions
Setup: Use one seed and fire repeated explosive families at different materials
Steps: Compare silhouettes ejecta smoke ember and debris then restart and repeat the sequence
Expected Result: Explosions differ by event weapon and material but the exact repeated input sequence reproduces the same result
Evidence Requested: Two matched captures and final hashes

Title: Systemic limbs bleeding and blood reactions
Setup: Use ballistic blunt explosive and heat damage against miners
Steps: Observe part injury severing bleedout clotting cautery blood flow stains heat water and traction
Expected Result: Vital destruction or bleedout kills; weapon classes affect parts differently; blood persists and reacts; and heat can cauterize bleeding
Evidence Requested: Short capture plus event/debug notes

Title: Eight-voice stereo chip synthesis
Setup: Use a stereo audio device and trigger overlapping fire hits blasts rope UI and bark events
Steps: Listen for overlaps and compare two deterministic audio self-tests
Expected Result: Original chip-style SFX use up to eight bounded voices with stereo placement; no music or samples play; and PCM hashes repeat
Evidence Requested: Audio device description PCM hashes and capture

Title: Perception and stateful AI
Setup: Enable debug AI labels and play at least two seeds
Steps: Hide break sight make noise damage a bot retreat and traverse a rope route
Expected Result: Bots visibly transition among roaming searching attacking and retreating using LOS sound memory tools and terrain without reading hidden player state
Evidence Requested: Seed state-transition notes and 60-second capture

Title: Miner Index navigation
Setup: Open Miner Index from the title screen
Steps: Move from first through last entry using only Up Down and Back
Expected Result: Exactly six rows are visible; arrows indicate overflow; selection eases between rows; and the right one-page detail changes automatically for every unlocked entry
Evidence Requested: First middle and last-entry screenshots

Title: How To Play one-pager
Setup: Open How To Play with keyboard and controller
Steps: Read the entire page and return with Back
Expected Result: Movement rope combat objectives spawn shield and both input layouts fit on one readable page without scrolling
Evidence Requested: Full-screen screenshot at default window size

Title: Lua sandbox validation
Setup: Build or use the script CLI
Steps: Validate official DIGS sources then validate fixtures attempting os io package debug loadfile and an instruction-budget loop
Expected Result: Official sources produce stable catalog hashes; forbidden capabilities and runaway scripts fail safely with readable diagnostics
Evidence Requested: CLI logs and source/catalog hashes

Title: Transactional F5 reload
Setup: Run a source checkout and make one valid then one invalid catalog edit
Steps: Press F5 after each edit
Expected Result: Valid data reloads with a new hash; invalid data reports an error and leaves the last valid catalog and running simulation intact
Evidence Requested: Before-after hash and error screenshot

Title: Miners versus Machines co-op
Setup: Choose two humans Miners versus Machines and friendly fire Off then On
Steps: Attack bots and each other under both settings
Expected Result: Humans share a team objective; bot opponents remain fair; and human friendly damage follows the explicit toggle
Evidence Requested: Setup screenshots and damage notes

Title: Input modes tuning persistence and rebinding
Setup: Open Options then Input & Controller and also open Controls
Steps: Cycle each P1 and P2 mode sensitivity deadzone and aim-slow setting; calibrate; rebind actions; relaunch; then restore defaults
Expected Result: Settings persist safely; AUTO changes source only on deliberate input; locked modes ignore the other gameplay source; calibration and conflict swaps work; defaults restore without changing simulation determinism
Evidence Requested: Input and Controls screenshots settings file values and tested mapping list

Title: Damage numbers and nonlocal health bars
Setup: Damage one local and one bot fighter repeatedly
Steps: Observe aggregates within 100 ms and wait without dealing damage
Expected Result: Local-human damage events show bounded aggregated numbers with configured size/color; nonlocal health bars appear on damage then fade
Evidence Requested: Short capture and setting values

Title: Exclusive two-player source ownership
Setup: Connect zero one then two controllers and choose two local players
Steps: Exercise AUTO KEYBOARD and CONTROLLER modes while deliberately alternating sources and disconnecting either pad
Expected Result: Every device owns at most one slot; idle sticks never steal keyboard input; one controller defaults to P2; two pads stay isolated; and source changes clear held fire jump and rope edges
Evidence Requested: Controller IDs selected modes and short capture

Title: Retro Standard and Carnage profiles
Setup: Run the same stress sequence under 768 1536 and 3072 budgets
Steps: Monitor effect counts frame time and final authoritative state
Expected Result: Each explicit simulation profile respects its selected cap and degrades safely; repeated runs with the same profile are deterministic; profile changes do not corrupt gameplay or crash
Evidence Requested: Three debug captures benchmark notes and hashes

Title: Archipelago continent and twin hills
Setup: Use recorded seeds that select each macro landform while holding map style constant
Steps: Zoom out inspect the full arena then traverse every reachable mass
Expected Result: The same material style produces three deterministic and visibly different macro layouts with useful sky safe terrain gaps edge drop-offs and exposed lava
Evidence Requested: Three seeds and three full-arena screenshots

Title: Spawn floor and overhead clearance
Setup: Start four-slot matches across all styles and landforms then jump beneath every generated metal anchor
Steps: Record every spawn and test the complete jump envelope below fixtures
Expected Result: Every fighter spawns on deep terrain rather than a suspended beam; no anchor boxes in a spawn or intersects the lower 28-cell traversal envelope
Evidence Requested: Seed spawn coordinates and clearance captures

Title: Authoritative lava projection
Setup: Start a match before the lava rise and move through every wheel zoom level
Steps: Compare the lava surface at close zoom and overview zoom then pan until it is offscreen
Expected Result: Only the true world-space lava horizon is drawn; zooming out reveals its actual position; close zoom has no fixed lava footer; and no camera edge exposes black
Evidence Requested: Matched screenshots for every zoom plus seed and tick

Title: Projectile muzzle safety
Setup: Stand in open space then near external walls and fire every projectile explosive
Steps: Fire along all cardinal and diagonal aim directions then repeat a deliberate close-wall shot
Expected Result: Projectiles clear the firing miner and launch envelope for six ticks; external walls still collide; and normal self-damage returns after clearance
Evidence Requested: Short capture with weapon aim direction tick and damage result

Title: Clock cap winner and draw
Setup: Open Customize Game and test two and three minutes with score cap Off 5 10 and 20
Steps: Reach time and score endings in FFA and Miners versus Machines including one exact tie
Expected Result: The full final tick resolves once; the correct individual or team wins; exact ties draw; and all active names scores deaths and end reason appear
Evidence Requested: Setup and results screenshots plus final event notes

Title: AUTO and ON FIRE timing
Setup: Test delay values 0 1 2 3 and 5 under both respawn modes
Steps: Die while holding Fire then release and press after readiness; repeat with a bot
Expected Result: AUTO returns at the selected delay; ON FIRE requires a fresh press; zero waits until the next step; bots return automatically; and the five-second shield remains
Evidence Requested: Countdown captures with mode delay and debug ticks

Title: Names editor and roster persistence
Setup: Configure one and two human matches with bots and edit every active slot by keyboard and controller grid
Steps: Use valid and invalid characters; relaunch; then complete a match
Expected Result: Names are uppercase and limited to twelve supported characters; human names persist; bot names last one match; nameplates killfeed and results resolve the correct slots
Evidence Requested: Editor setup gameplay and results screenshots plus sanitized values

Title: Hit marker confirms and crosshair pulse
Setup: Use each local human to damage and kill another miner while bots also fight
Steps: Compare local hits local deaths and bot-only events under each Flash setting
Expected Result: A struck miner tints red; the impact marker and attacker crosshair pulse once; local hit and kill confirms sound; fullscreen flashes follow Options; bot-only events stay compact
Evidence Requested: Short capture and audio or visual notes for P1 P2 and bots

Title: Multikill and killing-spree chain
Setup: Score kills inside and outside the three-second window then die after four uninterrupted kills and repeat to five
Steps: Observe the feed banners and announcer for every boundary
Expected Result: Two kills announce Double; three Triple; four or more Multi; five uninterrupted kills announce Killing Spree; expiry and death reset the correct counters
Evidence Requested: Timed event log or capture with player names and ticks

Title: Menu motif zoom click and master volume
Setup: Open every menu and Options then use mouse wheel zoom at each limit
Steps: Navigate rapidly; wait more than 1.5 seconds; test Accept Back zoom Shift-wheel and master values 100 50 and 0
Expected Result: Navigation walks the mining motif; idle resets it; only a successful unmodified wheel zoom clicks; Shift-wheel does not; and master zero is silent without stopping gameplay
Evidence Requested: Audio capture settings values and input sequence

Title: Announcer miner barks and bubbles
Setup: Enter the title then start a match and trigger Bark with P1 C P2 M and controller R3
Steps: Exercise six contexts and observe machines for at least sixty seconds
Expected Result: The deep voice announces title start and local awards; high miners speak matching bubbles; human speech is manual; and machine chatter stays sparse and non-tactical
Evidence Requested: Audio-video capture with contexts controller and approximate bark times

Title: World-aware wind water and lava
Setup: Visit open sky water and the lava basin at several camera zooms
Steps: Hold the camera over each material then move between them during combat
Expected Result: Smoothed procedural ambience follows visible world material and pan; at most two layers dominate; combat and speech remain readable; and hashes do not change
Evidence Requested: Audio capture seed camera position and before-after hashes

Title: Schema migration and atomic recovery
Setup: Back up the settings file then test schema 1 schema 2 an invalid file and a synthetic future schema
Steps: Launch change one option exit and compare the file after each case
Expected Result: Schema 1 migrates; schema 2 persists; invalid values fall back safely; a future schema is never overwritten; and a failed replacement retains the last readable file
Evidence Requested: Before-after settings copies exit status and option screenshots

Title: Stacked local death and award notices
Setup: Use both local players to score chained kills that also cross the five-kill spree boundary
Steps: Observe the centered notice rows killfeed audio and victim perspective
Expected Result: Named kill context remains visible beside Double Triple Multi and Killing Spree awards; couch players are unambiguous; and no notice corrupts or hides the results state
Evidence Requested: Short capture with active names kill ticks and visible notice rows
